prs.author: keurcien

(2 PRs)

prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: After a process restart, a freshly reloaded OAuthContext has no oauth_metadata in memory, so token refresh can fail or requires rediscovery to locate the token endpoint. (2 PRs)

members.author: yaowubarbara
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2654: Both touch the same line in stdio_server: the write_stream memory object stream is created with buffer size 0, which forces the writer to block until stdout_writer has fully drained the previous message. clusters.pick_reason: #2492 solves this by adding get_oauth_metadata/set_oauth_metadata to the TokenStorage protocol and persisting metadata across restarts, but every existing TokenStorage implementation must be updated to opt in (defaults to None otherwise) and it doesn't validate the metadata it loads. #3263 instead triggers discovery before a cold-start refresh directly in the client, using a new eager_discovery_attempted flag on OAuthContext to avoid re-probing on every in-process refresh, and adds an issuer-binding check on the discovered metadata — closing a validation gap #2492 doesn't cover — without requiring any change to the TokenStorage interface or third-party storage implementations.

members.author: yaowubarbara
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2654: Both touch the same line in stdio_server: the write_stream memory object stream is created with buffer size 0, which forces the writer to block until stdout_writer has fully drained the previous message. clusters.pick_reason: #2492 solves this by adding get_oauth_metadata/set_oauth_metadata to the TokenStorage protocol and persisting metadata across restarts, but every existing TokenStorage implementation must be updated to opt in (defaults to None otherwise) and it doesn't validate the metadata it loads. #3263 instead triggers discovery before a cold-start refresh directly in the client, using a new eager_discovery_attempted flag on OAuthContext to avoid re-probing on every in-process refresh, and adds an issuer-binding check on the discovered metadata — closing a validation gap #2492 doesn't cover — without requiring any change to the TokenStorage interface or third-party storage implementations.

clusters.pick_reason: Both add a quote-aware comma splitter, but #3041 goes further: it separates generic segment splitting (_split_www_authenticate_segments) from scheme identification, then explicitly compares the scheme token for exact equality (scheme.lower() == "bearer") before collecting its params. This directly targets the substring-match failure mode named in its title (e.g. a scheme like 'Bearer' being matched inside unrelated text), whereas #3012's _iter_www_auth_params only fixes comma-splitting within quotes and does not show any corresponding fix to scheme matching, making it a narrower fix for the same underlying parsing bug.
